issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents(): String, while the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning an int. The template leaves the method to be implemented, so students relying on the UML will implement a String return type and may produce a signature/type that does not match the intended numeric result or the solution/tests, causing confusion and test/compile failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the return type mismatch by updating the problem statement UML to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (preferred, since it represents a numeric total) and clarify the textual description to match. Alternatively, change the solution and any tests to return a String if that was the intended design, but prefer making the UML return int to reflect the numeric total.
